**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 09:41
- [EVENT] User is planning to organize their collectibles this weekend.
- [EVENT] User needs help organizing collectibles.
- [PREFERENCE] User collects figurines, Funko Pops, and vintage postcards.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended display cases for figurines: 
  - Detolf Display Case by IKEA: Affordable, five shelves, lockable door.
  - Umbra Trigg Vase Display Case: Modern design, three shelves, unique geometric design.
  - Glass Display Case by DisplayIt: Wall-mounted, locking door, adjustable shelves.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended display shelves for Funko Pops:
  - Funko Pop! Display Rack by Entertainment Earth: Holds up to 24 figures.
  - Pop! Vinyl Display Shelf by Diamond Select Toys: Holds up to 16 figures.
  - Acrylic Funko Pop! Display Case by BCW: Holds up to 12 figures.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended display cases for vintage postcards:
  - Postcard Display Rack by Cards Unlimited: Holds up to 24 postcards, wooden design.
  - Acrylic Postcard Display Case by BCW: Holds up to 12 postcards, compact design.
  - Postcard Shadow Box by Framebridge: Holds up to 6 postcards, stylish design.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended general shelving units:
  - Billy Bookcase by IKEA: Versatile, budget-friendly, adjustable shelves.
  - Cube Shelving Unit by ClosetMaid: Modular, customizable design.
  - Ladder Bookshelf by Sauder: Compact, rustic design.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised user to measure their space and consider the size of collectibles before making a purchase.
- [EVENT] User is looking for storage solutions for trading cards and coins.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended storage solutions for trading cards:
  - Binder Pages and Binders: Affordable, various sizes.
  - Top-Loaders and Semi-Rigid Holders: Protect individual cards.
  - Card Storage Boxes: Sturdy, compact boxes with dividers.
  - Card Albums and Folders: Stylish storage with pockets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended brands for trading card storage: Ultra Pro, BCW, Topps, PSA.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended storage solutions for coins:
  - Coin Albums and Folders: Designed for coins, with pockets.
  - Coin Capsules: Protect individual coins.
  - Coin Tubes and Rolls: Store larger quantities.
  - Coin Boxes and Cases: Sturdy storage with compartments.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended brands for coin storage: Whitman Publishing, Dansco, Intercept Shield, PCGS.
